game.title: Cult of Sweet Tooth
game.tagline: Craft in the morning. Serve in the afternoon. Spend in the evening.
ui.comingSoon: This part of the day is not built yet.
forecast.travelers: Mostly travelers and merchants are expected
weekday.market.note: Travelers and merchants come in numbers and contracts pay a quarter more.

node.extra-batch.desc: One more batch of the hand cauldron each day.
node.auto-cauldron.desc: A cauldron that makes Plain honey drops by itself every morning, using the day's honey.
node.dark-garden.desc: Dark sunflower seeds, the rare alternate of sunflower seeds, now sometimes come with the morning delivery. Needed for Perfect sunflower candies.
node.counter-space.desc: The shop can welcome more customers each day.
node.contract-board.desc: Merchants post orders with a quantity and a deadline.
node.hive-bond.desc: The hive keeps more royal jelly for you: the shelf holds one more and it arrives a little more often. Its visitors fill the shop.
journal.title: Journal
journal.first: The first day. The mice stared at the cauldron for a long while before anyone dared to stir.
journal.quiet: Few came today. The bees hummed something that sounded like sympathy.
journal.busy: A good day. The cauldron still smells of honey and ambition.
journal.rich: The coins piled so high tonight that the youngest mouse used them as a bed.
journal.lost: Some left empty-pawed. Sweet Tooth is patient; customers are not.
journal.clerk: The clerk counted the coins twice, then a third time, just to enjoy it.
journal.garden: The dark seeds whisper at night. Nobody asked what they say.
journal.fallback: Another day, another batch. The shop settles down for the night.
tree.title: Skill tree

save.autosaved: Your game saves automatically in this browser.
save.confirmNew: Start a new game? The current progress will be lost.
save.devMode: Dev mode (URL parameters): progress is not saved.

stage.rival: A rival hive steals {amount} {ingredient} each morning.
stage.complete: The offering is made. The shop runs on; the cult is pleased.
node.errands-board.desc: The hive and the temple post errands with lasting rewards.
node.map.desc: Reveals places around the shop as the weeks go by.
errands.title: Errands
errands.none: No errand is available right now.
errand.queen-fever.desc: The hive queen has a fever. Bring four Fine candy canes. The hive will repay you with more honey, for good, and once she is well the bees will visit your shop.
errand.pilgrim-feast.desc: The faithful plan a feast. Bring eight Fine sunflower brittles and the counter will be widened for good.
errand.rival-hive.desc: Send the clerk to parley with the rival hive for two days. If it works, the honey they steal comes back for good.
map.title: Around the shop
error.errand-unavailable: This errand is not available yet.
error.errand-not-active: This errand is not under way.
stage.rivalSoon: A rival hive will start stealing {amount} {ingredient} each morning from day {day} of the week.
stage.rivalNextWeek: A rival hive will start stealing honey once this goal is reached. Errands can stop it: prepare now.
stage.rivalHelp.needBoard: Errands can stop this: buy the Errands board (Temple branch).
stage.rivalHelp.available: The errand "{name}" can reduce it: take it on the Errands board.
stage.rivalHelp.locked: The errand "{name}" can reduce it once you have: {unlock}.
settings.title: Settings
save.seedHint: Leave empty for a random game, or type a number to replay the same game.
save.seedInvalid: The seed must be a whole number (digits only).
board.ringLegend: Rings on the icon: none = Plain, one = Fine, two = Excellent, three = Perfect.
save.newNote: You will be asked to confirm. Your current save is replaced.
node.sunflower-patch.desc: Sunflower seeds arrive every morning: opens Sunflower brittle, Sunflower nougat and more. Make a recipe by hand twice before the clerk can sell it.
node.sunflower-yield.desc: One more sunflower seed every morning.
node.pulling-machine.desc: Unlocks Excellent quality: more ingredients, a pulling step, a better price.
errand.magic-cauldron.desc: The old cauldron stirs by itself when it is fed well. Bring four Excellent candy canes and it will learn to make Perfect candies from rare ingredients: royal jelly, dark seeds and the like.
error.wrong-candy: This is not what they asked for.
serve.want.rich: A candy with {n} or more ingredients
craft.surplus: Unused ingredients are sold for coins when the shop closes (1 each). Rare ingredients are kept for Perfect candies.
craft.surplusMixed: Unused ingredients are sold for coins when the shop closes. Rare ingredients are kept for Perfect candies.
errand.royal-gift.desc: The queen is well again and the hive wants to thank you with its rarest gift. Bring eight Fine sunflower nougats for the feast and royal jelly will sometimes come with your honey.
node.reputation.desc: Pilgrims talk: every sale brings 6% more, rounded up (at least a coin more on cheap candies), per level.
errand.sweet-tooth-offering.desc: The cult asks for one thing: three Perfect Sweet Tooth candies, made of royal jelly, dark seeds, Stumpsville cream and cursed blackberries, laid before Sweet Tooth itself. After that the shop runs on and the cult is pleased.
node.milk-yield.desc: One more jug of milk every morning.
node.blueberry-yield.desc: One more handful of blueberries every morning.
errand.scarecrow-mice.desc: Crows keep eating the seeds in the hollow. Bring six Fine candy canes to the scarecrow mice and they will guard the patch for good: two more sunflower seeds every morning.
errand.dairy-cart.desc: A cart from Stumpsville has broken a wheel at your door, loaded with milk. Feed the dairy mice eight sunflower brittles and they will leave milk at your door every morning.
errand.bramble-thicket.desc: Behind the mill grows a thicket full of blueberries and thorns. Bring six Fine sunflower nougats to the thicket mice and the berries are yours, every morning.
errand.stumpsville-trade.desc: The dairy mice of Stumpsville used to make the richest cream in the valley. Bring six Fine honey fudges to open the old trade route: their cream will sometimes come with your milk.
errand.cursed-bramble.desc: One bramble bears black berries that whisper. The thicket mice will let you pick them if you bring six Fine honey-berry gums: cursed blackberries will sometimes come with your blueberries.
node.porter-mouse.desc: A mouse that carries every ingredient into the cauldron for you. You can still fill by hand.
node.stirrer-mouse.desc: A mouse that stirs for you. You can still stir by hand.
node.sculptor-mouse.desc: A mouse that shapes the candies for you. You can still shape by hand.
node.oven-timer.desc: The oven bakes on its own and takes the tray out at the right moment. You can still bake by hand.
node.pulling-motor.desc: A motor for the pulling machine. You can still pull by hand.
serve.pickOne: Pick a customer to see their order.
rating.title: Shop rating
error.cannot-automate: Nobody can do this step for you yet.
node.order-book.desc: The Second cauldron first works on the open contracts and delivery errands, with the cheapest quality that qualifies, then makes the candy you prefer. Pick it on the Craft screen.
node.delivery-mouse.desc: A mouse that hands in contracts and delivery errands as soon as the stock covers them (never the final quest).
craft.orders.mouse: The delivery mouse hands in finished orders by itself.
error.no-order-book: The cauldron has no order book yet.
craft.autoNone: {station} made nothing this morning (no ingredient left for its recipe).
node.dark-store.desc: A cool pantry for dark seeds: the shelf holds one more and they arrive a little more often.
node.cream-store.desc: A cold cellar for Stumpsville cream: the shelf holds one more and it arrives a little more often.
node.blackberry-store.desc: A deep basket for cursed blackberries: the shelf holds one more and they arrive a little more often.
node.foreman-mouse.desc: A mouse that runs the day: with your helpers it makes candy, serves the counter and waits for you in the evening. A switch lets you take over at any moment.
routine.status.afternoon: The mice are serving the shop…
routine.status.evening: Pick your upgrades, then end the day.
error.no-routine: Nobody can run the day yet.
error.routine-needs-helpers: Hire a porter, a stirrer and a sculptor mouse, and keep them helping, before the routine can make candy.
journal.quest-done: A goal is reached. Sweet Tooth stirred in its sleep.
quest.bonus: +{n} more coins if done within {days} days of opening
quest.q1.desc: The mice open the doors for the first time. Sweeten a few customers.
quest.q2.desc: Pilgrims start to hear of the shop. Let them taste it.
quest.q3.desc: Your name travels the road. Keep the cauldron warm.
quest.q4.desc: The pilgrims' table is set. More mouths, more candy.
quest.q5.desc: Something whispers from the old cauldron. Earn enough to listen.
quest.q6.desc: The hive blesses the shop. Crowds follow.
quest.q7.desc: Crowds at the door, every day.
quest.q8.desc: The long table is laid for the feast of Sweet Tooth.
quest.lend-a-paw.desc: Buy the Porter mouse: somebody has to carry the honey.
quest.queens-thanks.desc: Cure the sick queen with four Fine candy canes.
quest.hive-peace.desc: Send the clerk to parley with the rival hive.
quest.pilgrims-feast.desc: Feed the pilgrims who came a long way.
quest.scarecrow-watch.desc: Put the scarecrow mice to work in the fields.
quest.milk-and-honey.desc: Open the dairy cart road and bring milk to the shop.
quest.pulled-excellence.desc: Buy the pulling machine for Excellent candies.
quest.foreman-hired.desc: Hire the Foreman mouse and let the day run.
quest.magic-stirs.desc: Feed the old cauldron until it learns to make Perfect candies.
quest.stumpsville-road.desc: Open the trade route for cream.
